summary.fr: Sur le patch 16.21, Lee Sin support affiche 41,7 % de victoires sur 1 044 parties classées (Émeraude+), tier B. Il souffre surtout contre Blitzcrank, Lulu et Nautilus.
summary.en: On patch 16.21, Lee Sin support has a 41.7% win rate over 1,044 ranked games (Emerald+), B tier. It struggles most against Blitzcrank, Lulu and Nautilus.
